description.value: Buckhorn is a hike-in backcountry campground in E.C. Manning Park, located more than 1 km from any highway within the Cascade Mountains; a $5-per-person nightly permit fee applies, and advance reservations are required during peak summer season. Loaded bikes cannot access it — this is a foot-only wilderness overnight in one of BC's most popular backcountry parks.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: OSM tags confirm Buckhorn as a backcountry tent campground (backcountry=yes, tents=yes, capacity:tents=24) in E.C. Manning Park. The BC Parks website corroborates this and explicitly names Buckhorn as one of three peak-season reservable backcountry sites, with overnight permits required for all visitors. No campground-specific phone or address appears in OSM or on the website; the OSM URL is confirmed active and matches the fetched content.
concerns: Backcountry designation means access is trail-only (>1 km from highway/road) — may not be reachable by standard touring or road bike; local trail knowledge needed to confirm cycling access.
No campground-specific address or phone number available in OSM or on the website; only BC Parks general contact info is present.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Buckhorn is a legitimate, active backcountry campground, but its location more than 1 km from any highway or park road means access is trail-only; suitability for the WWC cycling directory depends on whether the approach trail is rideable by bike, which cannot be confirmed from available sources.
